page_title: Complete list of universities in United Kingdom | Mastersportal
overview: Looking for universities in United Kingdom? Browse our comprehensive list to explore and narrow down your choice by attendance and more.

listings.name: University of Surrey
listings.description: The University of Surrey is a global community of ideas and people, dedicated to life-changing education and research. With a beautiful and vibrant campus, we provide exceptional teaching and practical learning to inspire and empower our students for personal and professional success.

listings.name: University of Chester
listings.description: With around 14,000 students from 125 countries worldwide, the University of Chester provides a vibrant and diverse home for international students. It is a safe and inclusive environment, and was ranked the 1st place for international and postgraduate students in the WhatUni? Student Choice Awards 2024 and 2025.

listings.name: ESCP Business School
listings.description: Driven by european values, ESCP Business school inspires and educates business leaders who will impact the world.

listings.name: University of Bath
listings.description: Join our next Postgraduate Virtual Open Day on Wednesday 11 November 2026! University of Bath is known for excellence in teaching and research; a welcoming community; and rigorous workplace preparation. Our courses provide intellectual challenge and real-world relevance, allowing you to study with leading researchers in their field. Our campus, and location at the edge of the city, offer sporting, social and cultural opportunities. We are one of the safest campus sites in the UK.

listings.name: De Montfort University
listings.description: De Montfort University Leicester (DMU) is a dynamic institution with a long and vibrant history of improving people’s lives through education.

listings.name: University of Portsmouth
listings.description: The University of Portsmouth is situation on the south coast of the UK, and boasts some of the best weather in the UK. The city of Portsmouth is an exciting island city with lots of culture and has great entertainment choicesl It is also one of the top ten most affordable cities in the UK for students (Natwest Student Living Index).

listings.name: University of Sussex
listings.description: The University of Sussex is a leading research-intensive university near Brighton. We have both an international and local outlook, with staff and students from more than 100 countries and frequent engagement in community activities and services.

listings.name: Sheffield Hallam University
listings.description: Choose Sheffield Hallam, and you'll join a community of students and staff who are serious about academic achievement. Whatever course you choose, you will be inspired by excellent teachers, work with leading employers, and take part in a huge variety of extra activities.

listings.name: University of Southampton
listings.description: At the University of Southampton, they believe progress starts with people willing to think differently – who have the curiosity to explore, the confidence to question and the ambition to create momentum. They host 9,000 international students from over 140 countries

listings.name: School of Advanced Study, University of London
listings.description: The School of Advanced Study brings together eight research institutes and a number of centres of excellence at the University of London to form the UK's national centre for the support and promotion of academic research in the humanities.

listings.name: University of Brighton
listings.description: The University of Brighton is a friendly, diverse and inclusive community of 17,000 students from more than 140 countries. Learning at Brighton is all about doing. You’ll become skilled, confident and career-ready through practical experiences and work-related learning. Gaining a degree from the University of Brighton will prepare you for a successful career anywhere in the world.

listings.name: Teesside University
listings.description: Teesside University generates and applies knowledge that contributes to the economic, social and cultural success of students, partners and the communities we serve. Through education enriched by research, innovation, and engagement with business and the professions, we transform lives and economies.

listings.name: University of Glasgow
listings.description: The University has often been the starting point for significant journeys of discovery and collaboration. For over five centuries we’ve inspired people who have gone on to shape other great educational institutions around the world, and we maintain strong relationships with many of them to this day.

listings.name: University of Plymouth
listings.description: The University of Plymouth is based in the biggest city in the South West of England. With a campus in the centre of a vibrant coastal city, the university is located a short drive from local beaches and Dartmoor National Park. A modern, dynamic university with an educational history dating back to 1862. The institution is renowned for high-quality, internationally leading education, research and innovation.

listings.name: UCAM - Catholic University of Murcia
listings.description: UCAM - Catholic University of Murcia's main objective is to train the best professionals, people with a vocation for service who are capable of improving the society in which they live.

listings.name: University College Birmingham
listings.description: Based in the heart of the UK’s second biggest city, with over 10,000 students from around 90 countries, University College Birmingham is highly respected by employers and industry for providing career-focused education and training.

listings.name: University of Huddersfield Distance Learning Unit
listings.description: The University of Huddersfield is an award-winning institution with a reputation for teaching excellence, educating over 20,000 students from more than 100 countries. Our dedicated Distance Learning Unit offers a range of career-enhancing online courses which can be studied entirely online, from anywhere in the world, at any time, to give you the flexibility to fit your studies around your lifestyle. Our courses are designed with your career in mind, with many holding accreditations from leading industry bodies. Plus, our courses are designed and delivered in-house, meaning you’ll be taught by our talented, research-active academics, and benefit from the high standards in teaching that Huddersfield is renowned for.

listings.name: Goldsmiths University of London Online
listings.description: Goldsmiths, University of London (Online) offers a bold and distinctive learning experience, bringing world-class, career-connected education in technology and the social sciences to a flexible, fully online format. With over 120 years of academic excellence, Goldsmiths inspires students to think differently, challenge convention, and create meaningful change.

listings.name: Liverpool Hope University
listings.description: Liverpool Hope University pursues a path of excellence in scholarship and collegial life without reservation or hesitation. The University’s distinctive philosophy is to ‘educate in the round’ – mind, body and spirit – in the quest for Truth, Beauty and Goodness.

listings.name: SOAS University of London
listings.description: Set in the heart of London, SOAS challenges perspectives, broaches debate and empowers students to question the global status quo and find solutions to the issues facing the world today. The programmes are taught by respected international academics with interdisciplinary expertise who are engaged in fieldwork and research that influences governments, industries and communities across the world.

listings.name: University of Derby
listings.description: Located in the heart of England, we are Uni Compare’s University of the Year 2027 and are ranked 1st for employability, as voted for by more than 24,000 students. Offering industry-relevant, research-informed courses with strong industry links, we create unrivalled career opportunities allowing students to build a successful future. We are Gold in the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) 2023, making us one of the top universities in the country for outstanding teaching quality.

listings.name: UCL
listings.description: Studying for a graduate degree at UCL gives you a deeper understanding of your chosenfield and the opportunity to develop the cultural fluency and global outlook that areprized in today’s job market. You will join courses led by world-renowned experts andshaped by collaborations with people at the forefront of their field. Whatever youchoose to study, the potential for discovery is boundless.

listings.name: University of St Andrews
listings.description: The University of St Andrews is Scotland’s first university and the third oldest in the English-speaking world. We are consistently ranked among the top universities in the UK and Europe and are known for our award-winning student experience, our close-knit and caring international community, and our cutting-edge teaching and research.

listings.name: University of York
listings.description: Find your place at York and graduate with more than a qualification. A member of the prestigious Russell Group, the University of York is a globally celebrated research-intensive university located in one of England’s most historic cities. The University ranks 169th in the world (QS World University Rankings, 2026) and boasts nine subjects in the world top 100 (QS World Subject Rankings, 2025).

listings.name: The University of Lancashire
listings.description: The University of Lancashire is a leading modern university with roots stretching back to 1828. Set in the heart of the energetic and friendly city of Preston in the North West of England, we also have UK campuses in Burnley in East Lancashire and Cumbria as well as 120 international partnerships. We’re a thriving international university where people from all over the world can seize the opportunities they need to succeed in education, at work and for life.

listings.name: The University of Edinburgh
listings.description: The University of Edinburgh is one of the world's top universities, consistently ranked in the world top 50. Our entrepreneurial and cross-disciplinary culture attracts students and staff from across the globe.If you agree the future is a place of extraordinary possibilities, bring your limitless potential and join us. Anything could happen – extraordinary futures await.

listings.name: London Metropolitan University
listings.description: Based in one of the world's most exciting capital cities, London Met is home to a diverse community of inspiring and determined learners, teachers and innovative thinkers. We offer a wide range of courses, from undergraduate and postgraduate degrees to short courses and professional qualifications, many of which are available to study full-time or part-time to best suit your needs and lifestyle.

listings.name: London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine
listings.description: The London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine is a world-leading centre for research and postgraduate education in public and global health.

listings.name: The University for the Creative Arts
listings.description: The University for the Creative Arts (UCA) is a specialist institution that focuses on creativity and innovation, offering courses in fashion, film, fine art, graphic design, illustration, and more, across campuses in Surrey and Kent.

listings.name: Cranfield University
listings.description: As the UK’s only exclusively postgraduate university, Cranfield’s world-class expertise, large-scale facilities and unrivalled industry partnerships is creating leaders in technology and management globally.

listings.name: UWE Bristol (University of the West of England)
listings.description: Diverse, forward-thinking and less than 90 minutes from London, UWE Bristol is a thriving, modern university. We provide industry-relevant qualification focused on teaching you the skills you need to get the future you want.

listings.name: University of Sunderland
listings.description: The University of Sunderland is a global institution. Offering life-changing opportunities to thousands of students across the world, in our partner colleges and in our four main sites at Sunderland, London and Hong Kong. We are research active, with ten areas of 'world-leading’ research – real-world research that is taught in your lecture halls and labs.

listings.name: Loughborough University
listings.description: Study at a top 10 UK university

listings.name: University of Essex
listings.description: The University of Essex is where curiosity prevails, and where exploring new ways of thinking and pushing boundaries, isn’t just encouraged, it’s expected. It is determined to do things differently and put student success at the centre of everything we do.

listings.name: Aston University
listings.description: Students from over 120 countries choose to study at Aston University - a safe and friendly campus enjoyed by a global, multicultural community. Birmingham is one of the UK’s most diverse cities and home to an unrivalled cultural heritage, top sporting events, music, performing arts and outstanding world cuisine.

listings.name: Northumbria University
listings.description: Northumbria is a research-intensive, modern university with a global reputation for academic excellence. It was named UK University of the Year 2022 in the Times Higher Education Awards and is based in the heart of Newcastle upon Tyne, which is regularly voted the best city in the UK for students, and it also has a campus in London.

listings.name: Northeastern University
listings.description: Northeastern University is a global university system with 14 campuses, 49 alumni communities, and 3,900+ employer partners. Renowned for experiential learning, high impact research, and strong industry partnerships, it connects students, faculty, and innovators worldwide to gain real-world experience, drive collaboration, and solve global challenges together.

listings.name: Escape Studios
listings.description: Escape Studios is one of the UK's leading animation, games and VFX schools, supplying the industry with studio-ready talent. Its courses are designed and delivered with industry experts within a welcoming, close-knit and successful community.

listings.name: The London Interdisciplinary School
listings.description: The world's most complex problems don't respect subject boundaries. Neither do the people who solve them. The London Interdisciplinary School (LIS) teaches undergraduates, postgraduates and professionals to think across disciplines and lead where conventional expertise runs out. With a world-class faculty and strong industry links, LIS is for those who want to shape the world, not just fit in.

listings.name: University of Sussex Online
listings.description: The Virtual Learning Environment (VLE) is our digital alternative to the University of Sussex’s campus. It’s easy to navigate and accessible 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

listings.name: CIVIS Europe’s Civic University Alliance
listings.description: A pioneer of the first wave of European Universities Alliances, CIVIS brings together 11 leading research higher education institutions across Europe and 6 prestigious universities in Africa embarked on an odyssey to transform higher education. CIVIS is a vibrant community of over half a million students and 70.000 staff members, including 37.400 academics.

listings.name: Teesside University London
listings.description: Teesside University London is based at Here East in Stratford. Think a vibrant, contemporary space where you can study in your preferred way. A mix of quiet spots and collaborative areas.

listings.name: The University of Exeter
listings.description: At the University of Exeter, we offer exciting courses in beautiful and historic surroundings in South West England. As a member of the UK’s prestigious Russell Group of leading research universities, we combine excellence in teaching and research with an outstanding student experience.

listings.name: Lancaster University
listings.description: Lancaster is a top 10 UK university (Complete University Guide 2027) based on a green campus in north-west England. Here, you'll receive an exceptional education that will inspire and prepare you for a bright future. We offer a fantastic student experience, with our collegiate setup and diverse population creating a supportive, close-knit community.

listings.name: Leeds Beckett University
listings.description: Leeds Beckett University is a modern, professional Leeds-based university with a dedicated, diverse community.

listings.name: Bangor University
listings.description: A strong, confident institution recognised regionally, nationally and internationally as a centre of excellence for its varied portfolio of teaching and research, and for the unique, multicultural, inclusive experience it provides for its staff and students.

listings.name: University of Liverpool
listings.description: The University of Liverpool is a founding member of the prestigious Russell Group with a worldwide reputation for pioneering research and teaching by leading academics particularly relating to professions such as Medicine, Dentistry, Business, Law, Architecture and Engineering.

listings.name: Hult International Business School
listings.description: Ready to dare mighty things? At Hult you'll go beyond theory from day one. By collaborating across cultures and solving real challenges, you'll graduate ready to lead in an AI-driven world, with the skills and global network to last a lifetime.

listings.name: University of Reading
listings.description: The University of Reading is an integral part of the local community as well as a globally connected institution. We aim to be an inclusive and innovative place of study that makes a positive impact in the areas where our expertise can be benefit society.

listings.name: IPAG Business School
listings.description: IPAG Business School's mission is to educate managers for fast-changing worldwide environments and to produce quality research with national and international visibility.

listings.name: PFH Private University of Applied Sciences
listings.description: PFH Private University of Applied Sciences was recognised by the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture in 1995, which means that it is Lower Saxony's oldest private, state-recognised university.

listings.name: IESA - School of Arts and Culture
listings.description: Officially recognized by the Ministry of Culture since 1998, IESA offers a unique combination of academic knowledge and professional skills, which students can put into practice in jobs in France and abroad.

listings.name: London South Bank University
listings.description: London South Bank University's roots are in the real world. We offer industry-relevant degrees that mean you can become the best version of yourself. Here you’ll gain skills for life and the experience employers are looking for.

listings.name: University of Birmingham Online
listings.description: The University of Birmingham’s flexible online learning courses connect you with international faculty and peers, so you gain crucial career skills and an informed global perspective. As a member of the Russell Group, the University Birmingham also surrounds students with the top scholarly research and professional links in both the business and private sectors.

listings.name: Liverpool John Moores University
listings.description: Liverpool John Moores University (LJMU) stretches back to 1823, LJMU is now one of the largest and well-established universities in the UK. Within our five faculties, our research is influencing policymakers, improving people’s lives and finding solutions to the problems of the 21st century.

listings.name: Norland University of Early Childhood
listings.description: Norland University of Early Childhood is a prestigious institution specializing in early childhood education and care, offering a unique blend of theoretical knowledge and practical experience. Students pursue two distinct qualifications: a BA (Hons) degree in Early Childhood Education and Care, and the skills-based Norland Diploma.

listings.name: NHL Stenden University of Applied Sciences
listings.description: NHL Stenden University of Applied Sciences challenges its students, staff and partners to explore beyond existing solutions and possibilities, to discover and develop their talents so as to contribute to social progress.

listings.name: University of Kent
listings.description: Here at the University of Kent, they stand for ambition, with their diverse community of staff and students committed to making a difference at regional, national and global level. It’s something they're very proud of.

listings.name: Cardiff University
listings.description: Located in the heart of Cardiff, the capital city of Wales, Cardiff University is the only Russell Group university in Wales and is recognised globally for academic excellence, world-leading research and outstanding student support. Ranked 17th (The Center for World University Rankings 2026) in the UK and 179th in the world (QS World University Rankings).

listings.name: University of Leicester
listings.description: Located in the heart of the UK, the University of Leicester is renowned for its international excellence, pioneering research, and inspiring teaching. It has been named the Daily Mail University of the Year 2025 and shortlisted for University of the Year by Times Higher Education (THE) 2024 and The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2025.

listings.name: Politecnico di Torino
listings.description: For more than 150 years, the Politecnico di Torino has been one of the most prestigious public institutions at both the International and the Italian levels concerning education, research, technological transfer and services in all sectors of architecture and engineering.

listings.name: University of East Anglia
listings.description: The University of East Anglia (UEA) is a highly-ranked university located in the city of Norwich in the east of England. It is ranked in the UK Top 25 (Complete University Guide 2024) and World Top 300 (QS World University Rankings 2024). UEA is renowned for its strong academic programs, including Environmental Sciences, Computing, Business, Economics, Creative writing, and Global Development.

listings.name: University of Westminster
listings.description: Based in the heart of London, home to vibrant culture and global opportunities, the University of Westminster is where you can feel ​safe to explore and be yourself. ​Our practical and professional courses, delivered by expert educators, will give you the technical and transferable skills you need to progress and succeed. ​

listings.name: Queen's University Belfast
listings.description: Founded in 1845 as Queen's College Belfast, we became an independent university in 1908. Today, we are ranked 85 in the world (Times Higher Education Impact Rankings 2022), and a member of the Russell Group of UK research intensive universities, combining excellence in research and education with a student-centred ethos.

listings.name: Schiller International University
listings.description: The educational mission of Schiller International University (SIU) is to prepare students, personally and professionally, for future leadership roles in an international setting. In its undergraduate and graduate degree programs, SIU provides students with the competencies they need for professional careers as well as for further academic study.

listings.name: Manchester Metropolitan University
listings.description: At Manchester Metropolitan University, you’ll find a student experience as individual as you are. Study on a world-class campus in the heart of a global city, and join one of the UK’s largest and most diverse student communities.

listings.name: The Glasgow School of Art
listings.description: The Glasgow School of Art is one of Europe's leading higher education institutions for the education and research in the visual creative disciplines.

listings.name: University of Huddersfield
listings.description: The University of Huddersfield is a multi-award-winning, modern university with world-class facilities in a multicultural and thriving town. It is a modern public university, based on a site that has been home to academic institutions since the 19th century. Huddersfield’s culturally diverse student community brings in a global perspective, thereby enriching the university experience.

listings.name: Glion Institute of Higher Education
listings.description: We offer applied business education, combining academic rigor, hands-on practical skills and professional internships – all with a focus on developing the soft skills that are a prerequisite in the modern global economy.

listings.name: Brunel University of London
listings.description: Brunel University of London is an international university renowned for its education and research, and its spirit of innovation and entrepreneurship. Based on a single, leafy campus in west London, it provides outstanding learning and sports facilities, easy access to central London and a friendly, vibrant international community.

listings.name: European School of Economics
listings.description: The European School of Economics (ESE) is a private Business School without borders, multicultural and pragmatic, fully accredited in the UK and approved in the register of Learning Providers.

listings.name: University of Essex Online
listings.description: University of Essex Online provides 100% online, part-time undergraduate and postgraduate degrees and short courses. Our students benefit from a flexible approach to learning while receiving the same dedicated support they expect from a top 15 UK university (Guardian University Guide 2026). We're proud to be rated Gold in the Times Higher Education (THE) Online Rankings 2024.

listings.name: University of Bath Online
listings.description: The University of Bath’s online MSc courses will give you rigorous intellectual challenge and real-world experience, providing you with a gateway to ground-breaking research and sought-after careers. Packed with engaging, challenging, real-world content our online MSc courses will provide you with the tools needed to further your career.

listings.name: EIT Food
listings.description: EIT Food is network of educators, innovators and experts, partnering with universities all over Europe to help build a healthier, more sustainable future for food. We do this through a range of Masters and PhD programmes, online courses and summer schools.

listings.name: International Humanitarian College of London (IHCL)
listings.description: IHCL is built around the reality of adult learners. That means consistent academic support, career guidance and a community that understands your goals.

listings.name: University of Bristol
listings.description: The University of Bristol has an international reputation for high-quality education and research. Bristol welcomes students from more than 140 countries worldwide.

listings.name: Bournemouth University
listings.description: At Bournemouth University, we see growth as something lived from every angle. It's the full 360 degree of your experience - academic, social and everything in between. Your time at BU is shaped by real connections and real experiences, from the friendships you form to the professional skills you build on placement.

listings.name: University of Leeds
listings.description: The University, established in 1904, is one of the largest higher education institutions in UK. They are a world top 100 university and are renowned globally for the quality of the teaching and research. The strength of academic expertise combined with the breadth of disciplines they cover, provides a wealth of opportunities and has real impact on the world in cultural, economic and societal ways.

listings.name: Newcastle University
listings.description: A Global Top 130 university (QS World University Rankings 2025), we are dedicated to excellence, creativity and innovation, pioneering solutions that can change our world. Through world-class research we tackle some of the biggest challenges facing society globally. Through high quality teaching we educate for life, providing an outstanding student experience.

listings.name: Queen Mary University of London
listings.description: Queen Mary University of London is a place where every difference is celebrated –where your unique perspective is not just welcomed, but essential. Ranked 110th in the world (QS 2026) and 24th in the world for research (Times Higher Education 2026), join students from over 170 nationalities, and study at the only campus-based Russell Group University in London.

listings.name: University of Dundee
listings.description: The University of Dundee is a compact, city-centre campus where excellent teaching meets a supportive, global community. You'll study alongside internationally recognised researchers, equipping you with the knowledge and skills to create real-world impact and succeed in your chosen profession. We’re one of the UK’s top 25 universities (The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2026).

listings.name: University of Hertfordshire
listings.description: With its heritage in Britain’s pioneering aeronautical industry, the University has been an innovative force in education since the early 1950s. Today, it hosts a thriving community of more than 30,000 students who study 550-degree options at a vibrant, inclusive, campus-based institution.

listings.name: Kingston University
listings.description: Kingston University is committed to enhancing students’ life chances, supporting staff ambitions and strengthening the University’s impact on industry, policy and the professions to enable a sustainable future socially, economically and environmentally.

listings.name: University of Birmingham
listings.description: For more than a century, the University of Birmingham has been pursuing and sharing knowledge through outstanding teaching and world-leading research.

listings.name: Edinburgh Napier University
listings.description: Edinburgh Napier University is a modern, ambitious and innovative university located in Edinburgh, Scotland’s vibrant historical capital. At Edinburgh Napier we nurture talent and create knowledge that shapes communities all around the world.

listings.name: University of Stirling
listings.description: At the University of Stirling, being the difference is in our DNA. We're an international university with pioneering spirit and a global reputation for high-quality teaching and research. That's why we've been named Scottish University of the Year and UK Sports University of the Year in the Daily Mail University Guide 2027.

listings.name: University of Hull
listings.description: Founded in 1927, the University of Hull is one of the oldest universities in England. We have a long-standing reputation for delivering life-changing research and excellent teaching. We are an inclusive, progressive and supportive University: any student, from any background, can thrive here. A degree from Hull prepares you for shaping your own future, as well as the world around you.

listings.name: University of West London
listings.description: Welcome to the University of West London (UWL)! We are ranked as the best modern university in London (Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide) and the number one London university for overall student satisfaction (National Student Survey 2025). Our brand new facilities, amazing west London location and great career prospects are some of the reasons you should study at UWL.

listings.name: University of Gloucestershire
listings.description: UoG is a vibrant and friendly university welcoming students from all over the world. Our smaller size means we have a strong sense of community with outstanding support systems that enable students to thrive.

listings.name: Wrexham University
listings.description: Wrexham University is a learning community focused on inspiring its students to aim higher and achieve more.

listings.name: University of Wolverhampton
listings.description: Discover what The University of Wolverhampton has to offer! Each of the faculties contains a number of specialist Academic Schools delivering an exciting range of courses.

listings.name: University of Greenwich
listings.description: For over 130 years, the University of Greenwich has helped students explore their talents and achieve their professional goals. It offers a wide range of career-focused postgraduate courses across three campuses in London and Kent. You’ll soon feel at home within a welcoming international community and can look forward to specialist support, first-class facilities and one-to-one career advice.

listings.name: Abertay University
listings.description: Abertay University is a modern and friendly university in the heart of Dundee, Scotland, with a strong focus on teaching and preparing our graduates for the world of work. This is combined with excellence in research and knowledge exchange.

listings.name: Ulster University
listings.description: Ulster University, our students are at the heart of everything we do, and we want to give you the most rewarding student experience possible. We are committed to the delivery of campus based education. Learning, teaching, and research are social activities where people come together to create and share knowledge through collaboration and partnership. We are committed to the creation and nurturing of interactive shared spaces where people can benefit from research and industry-led learning across each of our campuses. Ulster University is recognised for our outstanding impact on student outcomes due to the excellence of our committed teaching community; delivering a learning experience that develops skills, raises ambitions, and prepares future leaders.

listings.name: International Career Institute (ICI) - UK
listings.description: The International Career Institute (ICI) is an independent and private provider of online education. ICI students are given skills that will change their employment prospects and increase their value to employers. The Institute listens to employers via its strong links to industry.

listings.name: Learna - Diploma MSc
listings.description: Learna | Diploma MSc offers online postgraduate education for healthcare professionals who want to study a PGCert, PGDip or MSc online while continuing with their busy work schedules. Our flexible, online programmes are fully accredited by the University of South Wales and The University of Buckingham, developed by medical experts around the world.

listings.name: University of Liverpool Online
listings.description: This year we are celebrating 25 years in online learning. All our programmes have been specifically designed for online delivery since 2000. Our state-of-the-art learning platform encourages collaboration with fellow professionals from around the world.The University of Liverpool achieved Gold in the Times Higher Education (THE) Online Learning Rankings 2024.

listings.name: Uppsala University
listings.description: Uppsala University is the oldest university in Sweden, founded in 1477, with a living cultural environment and extraordinary student life. There are 45,000 students here, and they are seen, heard, and noticed everywhere. World-class research and high quality education pursued here benefit society and business on a global level.

listings.name: University of Oxford
listings.description: Oxford has a distinctive collegiate structure. Students and academics benefit from belonging both to the University, a large, internationally-renowned institution, and to a college or hall, a small, interdisciplinary academic community.

listings.name: Trinity College Dublin
listings.description: Trinity College Dublin builds on its four-hundred-year-old tradition of scholarship to confirm its position as one of the great universities of the world, providing a liberal environment. Register now for the Environment Education Webinar on 23rd February: https://ad.doubleclick.net/ddm/clk/579407149;386946985;n

listings.name: Anglia Ruskin University
listings.description: Ranked in the world’s top 350 institutions in the 2021 Times Higher Education World University Rankings, ARU is a global university transforming lives through innovative, inclusive and entrepreneurial education and research. The students are at the heart of the University: their educational experience engages, challenges and empowers them to reach their full potential.

listings.name: Bath Spa University
listings.description: Bath Spa University is where creative minds meet. We teach and research across art, sciences, education, social science, and business. The University employs outstanding creative professionals who support its aim to be a leading educational institution in creativity, culture and enterprise.

listings.name: University of Bayreuth
listings.description: The University of Bayreuth is characterized by academic freedom, scientific progress, and practical relevance, all of which are understood in the context of social and cultural responsibility.

listings.name: University of Bedfordshire
listings.description: The University of Bedfordshire is a modern, innovative university with a heritage of top quality education going back more than 100 years. We nurture our students to become educated, employable and entrepreneurial global citizens.

listings.name: SDA Bocconi School of Management
listings.description: SDA Bocconi – the School of Management of Università Bocconi – has been creating and sharing knowledge since 1971. The School’s commitment to research and education has enabled it, over the years, to contribute significantly to the development of many industries, both in Italy and abroad.

listings.name: Solent University
listings.description: Through a global network of industry contacts, first-class facilities and an innovative blend of specialised knowledge and real-world experience, Southampton Solent University gives you the tools you need to take your career higher.

listings.name: Coventry University
listings.description: Coventry University is a global education group with a history dating back to 1843, known for its modern approach to teaching and strong employability rates. It offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and online courses across its main UK campus in Coventry, as well as in London and Scarborough.

listings.name: Robert Gordon University
listings.description: Robert Gordon University provides industry led undergraduate and postgraduate courses leading to highly relevant awards and degrees. Situated on one of the most beautiful campuses in the UK, the university provides facilities that will have a real influence on your capacity to learn.

listings.name: The University of Winchester
listings.description: We are a community committed to making a difference, passionate about seeing individuals and communities flourish.Our values of Compassion, Individuals Matter and Spirituality shape how we do this and why – we believe academic freedom leads to big ideas which in turn lead to social justice and creativity for a better world.

listings.name: University of Roehampton
listings.description: We change lives by helping our students to develop the confidence, knowledge and values they need for a successful and fulfilling life. We produce world-class research that helps us understand the world and change it for the better.

listings.name: University of Worcester
listings.description: The University of Worcester is a campus university and home to 10,000 students studying subject areas ranging from Business, Health to Sports, Arts or Science.The University offers a close-knit and high-achieving community where students are supported to succeed at every level and where every person counts as an individual.

listings.name: Lincoln Bishop University
listings.description: We've been educating students for over 150 years in the heart of historic Lincoln, a beautiful and extremely student-friendly city.

listings.name: University of London
listings.description: Study anywhere in the world with the University of London. Academic direction of our degrees is provided by world-class institutions, including LSE, UCL, and King’s College, London. You can also receive local face-to-face study support. We work with a number of teaching centres around the world that are approved to support our courses.

listings.name: TBS Education
listings.description: TBS Education brings together international knowledge, culture, and employability to ensure that you leave us with an internationally recognized degree, a global business and management perspective, and a professional network that will springboard you into your future.

listings.name: University of Cumbria
listings.description: The Cathedrals Group University recognise that education, now more than ever, must focus on a deeper purpose, a commitment to fairness, an inclusive ethos and a rounded view on how people grow and thrive.

listings.name: MIP Politecnico Di Milano
listings.description: We are the Business School of the Politecnico di Milano, one of the best scientific and technological universities in the world. For more than 40 years, MIP has been engaged in providing management training programmes for graduates, professionals, companies, institutions and public administrations.

listings.name: University of Aberdeen
listings.description: The University of Aberdeen is today at the forefront of teaching, learning and discovery, as it has been for 500 years. As the 'global university of the north', we have consistently sent pioneers and ideas outward to every part of the world. We are an ambitious, research-driven university with a global outlook, committed to excellence in everything we do.

listings.name: Technological University Dublin
listings.description: Technological University Dublin (TU Dublin) is Ireland’s first Technological University, offering a unique range of programmes and disciplines, with pathways to graduation from foundation and apprenticeship to undergraduate and doctoral levels.

listings.name: Leeds Trinity University
listings.description: Our students say it, our alumni say it and our staff say it – you really are a name, not a number, at Leeds Trinity University.Located on a beautiful campus six miles from Leeds – one of the UK’s best student cities – we’ve been providing outstanding, student-centred higher education for more than 50 years.

listings.name: University of Suffolk
listings.description: The University of Suffolk is a transformational university, absorbing the best of UK university traditions and aligning them with a twenty first century audience and a modern world of employment and entrepreneurship. We are a distinctive, thriving academic community which makes a clear and immediate impact.

listings.name: University Paris Dauphine
listings.description: It's mission is to educate future generations of executives, entrepreneurs, leaders and scholars to be both experts in their fields and socially responsible, cultured, open-minded members of the community.

listings.name: Edge Hill University
listings.description: Edge Hill University, located in Ormskirk in North West England, offers a dynamic, inclusive environment where high-quality teaching meets internationally recognised research. Just a short journey from Liverpool and Manchester, students enjoy vibrant city access while thriving in a supportive campus community. Ranked a Top 4 University in the North West (Complete University Guide 2025).

listings.name: BIMM University
listings.description: At BIMM University, we provide an extensive range of courses in modern music, performing arts, filmmaking, and creative technology to over 8,000 students across 14 schools in the UK, Ireland, and Germany.

listings.name: Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine
listings.description: Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine (LSTM), founded in 1898, was the first institution in the world dedicated to research and teaching in the field of tropical medicine.

listings.name: London School of Design and Marketing
listings.description: London School of Design and Marketing – LSDM – is a specialised school in Design and Marketing which aims to change the teaching paradigm with an innovative and creative education, 100% online and available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

listings.name: Westminster University
listings.description: Westminster is a private, non-profit, accredited, and comprehensive liberal arts college in Salt Lake City, Utah. Students experience the liberal arts blended with professional programs in an atmosphere dedicated to civic engagement.

listings.name: Global Institute of Sport
listings.description: The Global Institute of Sport (GIS) is the leading destination for degrees and executive education in the world’s most exciting sector. Driving the fast-paced world of sport, GIS is powered by a global network of industry leaders and elite stadium venues in the UK, US, Canada, Australia and Belgium.

listings.name: Institute for Equity, University Centre
listings.description: Institute for Equity, University Centre is a specialist research-led authority on EDI, leadership, organisational effectiveness, and professional standards. We offer flexible, 100% online postgraduate qualifications, including their executive MBA and Level 7.

listings.name: SHG Universities
listings.description: SHG International Hospitality & Business Schools represents a prestigious network of 12international business and hospitality schools operating under rigorous Swiss academic standards. Our institution stands at the forefront of hospitality education, combining theoretical knowledge with practical application.

listings.name: North Kent College
listings.description: Our highly skilled, committed staff will share their expertise and passion for education with learners of all ages post 16. We do this with energy, verve and joy in a uniquely warm and nurturing environment.

listings.name: Central Film School
listings.description: Central Film School is a specialist film institution that will provide you with hands-on practical experience and the essential skills needed to pursue a career in the screen industries.

listings.name: Tetr College of Business
listings.description: From MDs, CEOs and CTOs of leading unicorns to Ivy League professors, Tetr College of Business brings knowledge that blends theory with real-world impact.

listings.name: The University of Manchester
listings.description: Manchester is the only university in the UK to have social responsibility as a core goal. For you, this means we take our commitment to social responsibility seriously. We encourage you to become the best you can be and to make a difference in the real world by participating in Stellify

listings.name: Heriot-Watt University
listings.description: Heriot-Watt heritage dates back to 1821 since when our community of scholars has been developing transformational solutions to specific global problems.

listings.name: University of Lincoln
listings.description: Since Queen Elizabeth II opened the first University of Lincoln building on the Brayford Pool Campus, we have welcomed more than 90,000 students from across 135 countries. Today, we are listed in the world’s top 150 universities in the Times Higher Education’s (THE) Young University Rankings 2020, and hold a top five-star score overall in the QS Stars rating system of global universities.

listings.name: Durham University
listings.description: We produce world-leading and world-changing research across all three of our Faculties, our education is challenging, enabling, research-led and transformative and our wider student experience, delivered through our Colleges, Durham Students’ Union and Experience Durham, is among the best in the UK.

listings.name: University of South Wales
listings.description: The University of South Wales is a diverse academic community of many nations and beliefs, brought together by a shared commitment to the transformation of lives through knowledge and education.

listings.name: Middlesex University
listings.description: Students learn in a way that’s personal to them at Middlesex. They get real-life experience to put their knowledge into practice and develop advanced skills. Then they take their skills and experience and use them to learn throughout the rest of their lives.

listings.name: Arts University Bournemouth
listings.description: AUB is one of a small number of higher education institutions in the UK devoted solely to the study of art, design, media and performance. The University has been providing specialist education for over a century and enjoys a strong reputation, both nationally and internationally.

listings.name: University of Buckingham
listings.description: Buckingham is unique. It is the only independent university in the UK with a Royal Charter, and probably the smallest with around 2,700 students (approx 1,600 on campus). Honours degrees are achieved in two intensive years of study. We keep class sizes small, with a student:academic staff ratio of 10.4:1 and the Oxbridge style tutorial groups are often personalised and always exhilarating.

listings.name: London School of Business and Finance - Online
listings.description: London School of Business & Finance offers industry-focused programmes designed to reflect global market trends. LSBF attracts the most talented and ambitious candidates from around the world and works together with its corporate partners to develop programmes structured with an up-to-date and international perspective in mind.

listings.name: Royal Veterinary College
listings.description: The Royal Veterinary College is the largest and longest-established vet school in the English-speaking world and is a college of the University of London. The RVC offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in veterinary medicine, veterinary nursing, and biological sciences; and CPD programmes in veterinary medicine and veterinary nursing.

listings.name: ICD Academy for Cultural Diplomacy
listings.description: The Academy for Cultural Diplomacy aims to develop and raise awareness of the theory and practice of cultural diplomacy and related fields (such as global governance, international law, human rights, sustainable economies, creative industries, etc.) as well as to explore new strategies for the strengthening of intercultural relations and promoting global peace.

listings.name: Glasgow Caledonian University
listings.description: Glasgow Caledonian University has become one of the largest universities in Scotland with over 20,000 students. The campus is self–contained and situated right in the heart of the lively city of Glasgow. A distinctive, inclusive and forward-looking university, GCU is committed to its social mission to promote the common good.

listings.name: Royal Agricultural University
listings.description: When the RAU opened as a College in 1845, it had 25 students. Our goal is to nurture people’s enthusiasm for the environment, and to help them make a difference by developing their skills and their perspective.

listings.name: Ecole de Management de Normandie
listings.description: Ecole de Management de Normandie has innovated for 150 years to guarantee a degree of excellence that matches its ambitions. A spirit of conquest inherited from its history and its Normandy roots, enabling the School to be ranked among the Top 90 Best European Business Schools in the Financial Times ranking.

listings.name: American University of Greece
listings.description: The American College of Greece, a non-profit institution, values its dynamic alumni network and offers transformative education through specialized undergraduate and postgraduate programs. Deree emphasizes Arts and Philosophy, while Alba Graduate Business School focuses on Masters of Science and Business Administration programs.

listings.name: City St George's, University of London
listings.description: City St George's, University of London is the UK’s only dedicated medicine and health sciences university. Our campus is based within a teaching hospital, so you will be immersed in a professional environment from day one. Our courses ensure that your skills and experience stand out to employers, and you will learn from academics with real on-the-job experience.

listings.name: Brighton School of Business and Management
listings.description: The company has developed into an international online distance learning College, offering a wide range of UK accredited and internationally recognised Management and Business qualifications, at both graduate and postgraduate levels.

listings.name: Cardiff Metropolitan University
listings.description: Cardiff Metropolitan University delivers professionally recognised degrees, together with impactful research and innovation, in art and design, business and management, education and public services, sport and health sciences, and technologies and engineering. International students are valued and respected for the unique experiences and perspectives that they contribute to university life.

listings.name: Ravensbourne University London
listings.description: We're an innovative, industry-focused university located in the heart of London. We're champions of creativity and collaboration, dedicated to giving our learners the specialist skills and opportunities they need for outstanding careers in digital media and design.

listings.name: London School of International Business
listings.description: London School of International Business (LSIB) is a decade old institution offering a wide range of Degree and Diploma Courses delivered 100% online. We are proud of our global community of over 10,000 successful alumni.

listings.name: University of Chicago
listings.description: The University of Chicago is an urban research university that has driven new ways of thinking since 1890. Our commitment to free and open inquiry draws inspired scholars to our global campuses, where ideas are born that challenge and change the world.

listings.name: Cambridge School of Visual & Performing Arts
listings.description: Providing pathways in Art & Design, Drama and Music, Cambridge School of Visual & Performing Arts continues to develop the skills and confidence of many inspiring artists and performers.

listings.name: Blackburn College
listings.description: Blackburn College is the largest Further Education college in Pennine Lancashire and one of the largest providers of Higher Education for a college in England. Since 1888, people from all over Lancashire and beyond have developed their skills, re-trained and moved to higher levels of study with Blackburn College's support.

listings.name: The University of Law Business School
listings.description: At The University of Law we’ve been developing innovative teaching methods for our law courses for over 100 years, making us one of the UK’s longest-established specialist providers of legal education. We’re bringing this expertise in quality education to the business world with our Business School for both undergraduate and postgraduate.

listings.name: The Royal Central School of Speech and Drama
listings.description: The Royal Central School of Speech and Drama is part of the University of London and is widely regarded as one of the top training institutions for those wishing to work in the performing arts. Located in Swiss Cottage, north London, the school resides within a hub of vibrant local community of arts organisations and is moments away from the prestigious, West End.

listings.name: The Institute of Cancer Research
listings.description: The Institute of Cancer Research, London, is one of the world’s most influential cancer research organisations.

listings.name: Stanmore School of Business
listings.description: Stanmore School of Business is one of London's best online business schools. With over a decade of teaching and Learning experience, we shape business practice and transform careers across the globe. Our academic strength inspires an authentic and provocative business mind, empowering our students to develop a truly innovative approach in a unique academic environment.

listings.name: University of Gibraltar
listings.description: At the University of Gibraltar we are driven by our mission to build an institution that creates opportunity for our students and graduates. We invite you to join a growing community of students and take your next steps with us.

listings.name: Sotheby's Institute of Art
listings.description: Sotheby’s Institute of Art offers a unique academic approach to studying the global art market and also provides exposure to specialized topics that are central to the history and ongoing development of the international art world.

listings.name: Arden University UK
listings.description: Arden University believes that everyone, everywhere has a right to a Higher Education. It’s a path that leads to both personal progress and enrichment.

listings.name: National Motorsport Academy
listings.description: The National Motorsport Academy offers the World’s Leading Online Motorsport Engineering Degrees. The BSc (Hons) and MSc degrees are awarded by our academic partner De Montfort University, Leicester (DMU), ranked in Times’ top 3% of world universities.

listings.name: Leeds Conservatoire
listings.description: Discover the Leeds Conservatoire with live and on-demand content including course talks, student Q&As, virtual tours, performances and more.

listings.name: Regent College London
listings.description: Regent College London (RCL) is a diverse community active in promoting learning and education, with an established record of success rates within UK Higher Education. You will experience an exciting time of study and interaction within an environment geared to draw the best from students, supported by a dedicated team of professionals at all levels who always put students first!

listings.name: Unicaf - University of East London
listings.description: Unicaf is a global delivery partner of the University of East London, UK, responsible for the recruitment, admission, enrolment and support of online learners to University awards approved for distance online delivery. On successful completion, graduates will receive a University of East London award.

listings.name: Renewable Energy Institute
listings.description: The Renewable Energy Institute has been running training courses since 1975 and has a wealth of experience in education for the renewable energy and energy efficiency sectors. Participants benefit from the practical and theoretical knowledge of a range of renewable energy and energy efficiency systems, taught by university professors and leading experts in their field.

listings.name: Exeed College
listings.description: Exeed College envisages to be among the foremost global providers of recognized and accredited higher education, executive education and continuing education to working professionals and practitioners in order to equip, enrich and empower them to become experts and leaders in their domains of practise.

listings.name: University of the West of Scotland
listings.description: University of the West of Scotland is one of Scotland aims to have a transformational influence on the economic, social and cultural development of the west of Scotland and beyond.

listings.name: University of Nottingham
listings.description: The University of Nottingham was founded on the vision and philanthropic spirit of Jesse Boot who, in 1928, donated the land that is now University Park. The vision of a university devoted to discovery, enterprise and the advancement of the human condition, combined with his lifelong commitment to improving health and wellbeing, remains intrinsic to the culture of the University today.

listings.name: University of Strathclyde
listings.description: The University of Strathclyde is a public research university located in Glasgow, Scotland. Founded in 1796 as the Andersonian Institute, it is Glasgow's second-oldest university, having received its royal charter in 1964 as the first technological university in the United Kingdom.

listings.name: Royal Holloway University of London
listings.description: The Royal Holloway University of London is a pioneering university, steeped in history and culture, yet constantly evolving and adapting to the demands of modern higher education.

listings.name: Norwich University of the Arts
listings.description: Norwich University of the Arts emerged in the 19th century from a thriving tradition of craft and artistic activity in the city of Norwich. Today, that flame of creative exchange burns brighter than ever. They are engaged in the dynamic debate about the nature and future of creativity through different practices and disciplines, established and emerging art forms, research, and experimentation.

listings.name: University of East London
listings.description: UEL is a public university founded in 1898, located across three modern campuses in East London, Docklands, Stratford, and University Square Stratford. With 160 nationalities represented among over 40,000 students, UEL fosters a truly global, inclusive community. Named University of the Year for Teaching Quality by the Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2025, UEL delivers career-first education.

listings.name: King's College London
listings.description: King’s is one of the world’s leading universities, ranked among the UK top 6 and globally recognised for excellence in education, research and employability. King’s combines nearly 200 years of academic heritage with a modern, international outlook. At King’s you’ll join a diverse community of students and benefit from outstanding teaching informed by world-changing research.

listings.name: NABA, New Academy of Fine Arts
listings.description: NABA, Nuova Accademia di Belle Arti, ranks first among Italian Academies of Fine Arts and 41st worldwide for Art & Design in the QS World University Rankings® by Subject 2026. Founded in Milan in 1980, NABA has built its international reputation on a distinctive teaching method that connects creative experimentation with contemporary culture and professional practice.

listings.name: University of Deusto
listings.description: The University of Deusto aims to serve society through its contributions with a Christian approach to today’s realities.

listings.name: Birmingham City University
listings.description: With around 23,500 students from 80 countries, Birmingham City University is a large, diverse and increasingly popular place to study. We put students at the heart of everything we do, giving them the best opportunities for future success. The University has an enviable reputation for providing quality, student-focused education in a professional and friendly environment.

listings.name: University of the Highlands and Islands (UHI)
listings.description: Scotland's stunning landscapes are home to the University of the Highlands and Islands. Our reputation is built on our distinctive research and curriculum – all enriched by the people, natural environment, economy, culture and heritage of our region.

listings.name: University of Northampton
listings.description: Northampton is one of the youngest universities in the UK but we are already leading the way in adding value to society, which we call social impact. We have won multiple awards for our work in this area, among others, but what matters the most to us is ensuring that our students and graduates have the opportunity to make their mark on the world too.

listings.name: University of the Arts London (UAL)
listings.description: The University of the Arts London is one of the most renowned international institutions in arts, design, fashion and communication. UAL has 6 constituent Colleges: Camberwell College of Arts, Central Saint Martins, Chelsea College of Arts, London College of Communication, London College of Fashion and Wimbledon College of Arts; and newly founded Creative Computing Institute.

listings.name: London School of Economics and Political Science
listings.description: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE) offers you the opportunity to study the social sciences in an institution with a worldwide academic reputation, while enjoying the cultural, social and recreational facilities of one of the world’s greatest capital cities.

listings.name: London Business School
listings.description: London Business School. A global and vibrant business community in two of the world’s most dynamic cities, London and Dubai. Where extraordinary minds and diverse perspectives connect, in a truly inspiring environment, to have a profound impact on the way the world does business and the way business impacts the world.

listings.name: Bucks New University
listings.description: Bucks New University delivers an education that works for all, regardless of background or circumstance, and provides skills for life, to meet the global challenges of the 21st century. Student satisfaction is at the heart of everything it does. It prides itself on ensuring their students reach their full potential through it employment-focused and skills-based education.

listings.name: Rose Bruford College
listings.description: Rose Bruford College is a renowned performing and production arts institution in Southeast London, offering a range of prestigious degrees. For over seven decades, it has been at the forefront of arts education, training leading talent now working in theatre, television, and film worldwide.

listings.name: Regent's University London
listings.description: Regent’s University London offers a career-focused education from a secure, central London campus nestled within a Royal Park. Students step into a close knit, 80% international community where small classes, meaningful industry connections and real world learning open doors to new confidence, new perspectives and new horizons. Put simply, Regent’s is about cultivating possibility.

listings.name: The New School
listings.description: Discover a new kind of university in New York City, one where scholars, artists, and designers come together to challenge convention and create positive change. The New School is home to top-ranked Parsons School of Design, Eugene Lang College of Liberal Arts, the College of Performing Arts, The New School for Social Research, and a variety of career-focused graduate degree programmes.

listings.name: London Film School
listings.description: London Film School is the UK’s oldest film school. We train the world’s next great filmmakers and storytellers in a collaborative and intensive film environment. We create global networks for life. We do this because we believe film is the most complete, democratic, and influential art form, as well as a vital and growing industry.

listings.name: Peking University
listings.description: Founded in 1898, Peking University was originally known as the Imperial University of Peking. It was the first national university covering comprehensive disciplines in China, and has been a leading institution of higher education in China since its establishment. It also served as the highest administration for education at the beginning of its founding.

listings.name: Strathclyde Business School
listings.description: Strathclyde Business School is an internationally recognised, triple-accredited institution known for shaping future business leaders. Frequently highlighted in business school reviews, it stands out for academic excellence and global reach. For anyone asking “is Strathclyde Business School good?”, its reputation and strong links to industry place it among the top MBA programmes in the UK.

listings.name: Fairleigh Dickinson University
listings.description: Fairleigh Dickinson University is a center of academic excellence dedicated to the preparation of world citizens through global education. The University strives to provide students with the multi-disciplinary, intercultural, and ethical understandings necessary to participate, lead, and prosper in the global marketplace of ideas, commerce, and culture.

listings.name: Harper Adams University
listings.description: Harper Adams is a University focused on food production, animal health, and their contribution to sustainable living environments. It offers research and study across Science, Technology, Agriculture, Business, Economics, Food, Land Management, Environment, Engineering, Entomology, Plant Science, Animal Welfare, Veterinary Science, Farming, Sustainability, Enterprise, Digital, Data, and Policy.

listings.name: Northeastern University London
listings.description: Northeastern University London is located in central London, with students and staff from nearly 100 nationalities. Our undergraduate and master’s programs feature small class sizes, state-of-the-art facilities, and strong student support. Designed around real-world challenges, our courses enhance skills, confidence, and career prospects inside and outside the classroom.

listings.name: York St John University
listings.description: We pride ourselves in our community here at York St John University. It’s a close-knit, inclusive place that offers a lot more than a degree certificate. With official ‘Sanctuary’ status, we see our role as something bigger than an education provider.

listings.name: Plymouth Marjon University
listings.description: Plymouth Marjon University sits on a green and spacious campus, with world-class facilities in a spectacular part of the world. But the thing that most makes us stand out is our students. They are the inspiration and motivation for all we do.

listings.name: American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine
listings.description: At American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine, our mission is to train tomorrow’s physicians, whose service to their communities and their patients is enhanced by international learning experiences, a diverse learning community, and an emphasis on social accountability and engagement.

listings.name: The University of Hertfordshire Online
listings.description: If you’ve been thinking of making a change in your career, then now is that time. With University of Hertfordshire's fantastic range of courses that are completely online, you can take the steps you need to enhance your education and advance in your chosen career.

listings.name: Arts University Plymouth
listings.description: Arts University Plymouth prepares graduates who can provide creative solutions to the complex global challenges of our times. listings.name: Global Banking School UK
listings.description: Get a degree, advance your career, start a business, grow a business. Whatever your dream, we are passionate about helping you get there! See how Global Banking School UK can change your life.

listings.name: Unicaf - University of Suffolk
listings.description: The partnership between the University of Suffolk and Unicaf brings together the resources and capabilities of both organisations to offer innovative learning solutions and programmes which are delivered fully online to the needs of a wide range of professionals.

listings.name: Le Cordon Bleu

France is the first touristic country in the world and welcomes more than 85 million international tourists each year.

listings.name: European College of Business and Management
listings.description: The ECBM specialises in the provision of customised Business and Management programmes by working in close partnership with employers and UK universities.

listings.name: Amity University London
listings.description: Amity University (in) London is located in the academic Bedford Square in Central London right next to British Museum. It is part of Amity, a leading global education group with 175,000 students studying across campuses in 12 counties.

listings.name: Nottingham Trent University
listings.description: NTU is one of the most sustainable universities in the world and we have been awarded Green Flags for our Brackenhurst and Clifton Campuses.

listings.name: Goldsmiths, University of London
listings.description: Goldsmiths, University of London is based in South East London and has a world-class reputation for its degrees in the creative arts, humanities and social sciences. It has been a member of the University of London for over 100 years, with a wide variety of subjects on offer, industry-standard facilities, and a campus buzzing with creative energy with students and staff from over 130 countries.

listings.description: The University of Warwick is a British campus university located on the outskirts of Coventry, West Midlands, England. It was established in 1965 as part of a government initiative to expand access to higher education, and in 2000 Warwick Medical School was opened as part of an initiative to train more doctors in Britain.

listings.name: Swansea University
listings.description: Swansea University is a research-led university that has been making a difference since 1920. The University community thrives on exploration and discovery, and offers the right balance of excellent teaching and research, matched by an enviable quality of life.

listings.name: Ashridge Business School
listings.description: Our focus is on practical learning, because we know that knowledge through theory alone is not enough. Everything we do is powered by research, which means we constantly review and update our programme content to stay current and relevant to leaders and organisations. Something we have been doing for over 60 years.

listings.name: Imperial
listings.description: Welcome to Imperial College London, a world-leading university for science, technology, engineering, medicine and business (STEMB). And the research and innovations we produce are right now helping to navigate some of the worldʼs toughest challenges in global health, climate change, AI leadership and more.

listings.name: University of Salford
listings.description: Research at the University of Salford extends across schools, research centres, and industry partners, fostering a truly unique approach to collaborative learning. The Research Excellence Framework (REF) assesses the quality of research in UK academic institutions, and we have achieved excellent results.

listings.name: Canterbury Christ Church University
listings.description: The mission of Canterbury Christ Church University is to pursue excellence in higher education: transforming individuals, creating knowledge, enriching communities, and building a sustainable future.

listings.name: The University of Wales Trinity Saint David
listings.description: At UWTSD, we offer career-focused degrees with strong industry links, ensuring you gain the skills employers need. With small class sizes and a personalised approach, you'll benefit from hands-on learning, work placements, live projects, and entrepreneurial support.

listings.name: Royal College of Art
listings.description: Ranked the world’s number 1 art and design university for twelve consecutive years (2015–2026). The Online Q&A Week (5–8 May 2026) offers free virtual sessions where you can explore programmes, and ask questions directly.
