listings.name: EDHEC Business School
listings.description: Founded in 1906, EDHEC is now one of Europe’s top 15 business schools. Based in Lille, Nice, Paris, London and Singapore, and counting over 90 nationalities on its campuses, EDHEC is a fully international school directly connected to the business world. With over 40,000 graduates in 120 countries, it trains committed managers capable of dealing with the challenges of a fast-evolving world.

listings.name: WMG University of Warwick
listings.description: WMG is an academic department at the University of Warwick and is the leading international role model for successful collaboration between academia and the public and private sectors, driving innovation in science, technology and engineering, to develop the brightest ideas and talent that will shape our future.

listings.name: The Open University UK
listings.description: We are The Open University and believe world-class university education should be open to anyone anywhere. So, wherever you are in the world, you can open up your future with the OU.

listings.name: OMNES Education
listings.description: As a leader in private higher education, OMNES Education is the only group to offer a range of lifelong learning programs that cover the main areas of higher education and research:

listings.name: Guildhall School of Music & Drama
listings.description: The Guildhall School is a vibrant, international community of young musicians, actors and production artists in the heart of the City of London.

listings.name: The Courtauld Institute of Art
listings.description: The Courtauld Institute of Art is the world’s leading centre for the study of the history and conservation of art and architecture. Its Gallery houses one of Britain’s best-loved collections. Through its unique integration of activities, facilities and resources, The Courtauld provides an exceptional environment for research, learning and professional development.

listings.name: UCFB x GIS
listings.description: A world first in higher education, the University Campus of Football Business (UCFB) offers unique university degrees focused on a career in the football and sports industry.

listings.name: Centre for Alternative Technology
listings.description: CAT is an educational charity dedicated to researching and communicating positive solutions for environmental change. Find out more about what we do and how you can get involved.

listings.name: MetFilm School
listings.description: MetFilm School is a leading film, television, and online media school offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and short courses across various craft areas.The School has campuses in London within the famous Ealing Studios and Garden Studios, in Berlin at Molecule Studios and House of Music (from 2024/25), and in Leeds at Prime Studios.

listings.name: Plumpton College
listings.description: Established in 1926, we have continually developed and built a curriculum and business support framework across the South East, with now over 3500 students and 2500 businesses across our four centres (Plumpton, Stanmer, Netherfi eld and Flimwell).

listings.name: University of Bradford
listings.description: Our focus is on creating the conditions for social, cultural, and economic impact. We are committed to social inclusion and our work to expand opportunity and enable students to reach their potential has led to us topping the Social Mobility Index of English universities for the last four years.

listings.name: Istituto Marangoni
listings.description: The essence of fashion and design: this is what is taught at Istituto Marangoni. Professionals who are passionate about their work and willing to share their expertise teach the young talent who, once graduated, will reach the highest professional levels. Through a complete course, where theory is taught alongside practice, students learn that creativity is a gift to be nurtured, nourished and stimulated continuously, with passion and dedication. It is the same passion for the world of fashion and design with which our teachers teach.

listings.name: The Scottish Association for Marine Science (SAMS)
listings.description: The Scottish Association for Marine Science (SAMS) is Scotland’s largest and oldest independent marine science organisation, dedicated to delivering marine science for a healthy and sustainable marine environment through research, education and engagement with society.

listings.name: Brighton and Sussex Medical School
listings.description: Brighton and Sussex Medical School (BSMS) is an equal partnership between the Universities of Sussex and Brighton together with NHS organisations throughout the South East region. The school offers undergraduate medical training, a range of postgraduate taught courses and postgraduate research.

listings.name: London School of Planning and Management
listings.description: London School of Planning and Management (LSPM) is dedicated to advancing the frontiers of the study of management and planning, through its research, collaboration across the entire LSPM, and its commitment with enterprises, organizations, and leaders throughout the world.

listings.name: Hartpury University
listings.description: Hartpury College and University Centre is one of the UK’s leading land-based and sports educational establishments. Our stunning specialist campus covers more than 360 hectares and is located near to both Gloucester and Cheltenham.

listings.name: Brunel University London - Online
listings.description: Brunel University London is named after Britain’s influential engineer, Isambard Kingdom Brunel. Established in 1966, Brunel University London has been providing academic excellence for over 50 years, and are proud to be 34th in the world for international outlook (Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2020).

listings.name: Hyper Island
listings.description: The university believes in people's ability to lead change — in themselves, in their workplaces, and in the world around them. Hyper Island is a global education group that equips individuals and organisations to grow in a rapidly changing world through hands-on, reflective, and relevant learning.

listings.name: ThinkSpace Education
listings.description: ThinkSpace Education is an online school that brings professional working composers, orchestrators and sound designers together with students, looking to enter the film, games and TV music industries.

listings.name: Metropolitan School of Business & Management (UK)
listings.description: We fortify our learners with the tools needed to succeed, to include goal setting, planning, putting plans into action. We believe that anyone can achieve success, anyone who studies with MSBM.

listings.name: Unicaf - Liverpool John Moores
listings.description: Unicaf is a global delivery partner of the Liverpool John Moores University, UK, responsible for the recruitment, admission, enrolment and support of online learners to University awards approved for distance online delivery.

listings.name: King Stage Business School
listings.description: King Stage Business School is a business school based in London. As a leading school specialising in innovation and sustainability, our aim is to empower the next generation to tackle the challenges of tomorrow. Our modern teaching methods and career support are designed to allow students to thrive. Start your career in sustainability and innovation today.

listings.name: MLA College
listings.description: MLA College is a specialist in global education, earning acclaim as an award-winning Higher Education provider. Specialising in UK distance learning degrees, which can be studied from anywhere in the world, our focus extends beyond boundaries, particularly within the dynamic marine and maritime sector.

listings.name: Architectural Association
listings.description: The Architectural Association is committed to extending the support it offers to help ensure that the most talented students are able to study at the school, regardless of their financial means.

listings.name: Walbrook Institute London
listings.description: They are Walbrook Institute London. They equip future leaders with the skills and expertise employers want, by combining 145 years of heritage with pioneering educational technology. Join them and take the next step toward progress.

listings.name: Academy of Live Technology
listings.description: The Academy of Live Technology is where live industry learns. It’s everything that goes into creating live experiences, at the heart of where it all happens. We are situated on a thriving global hub for live entertainment, where some of the world’s biggest shows and tours are staged.

listings.name: Falmouth University
listings.description: Falmouth University is a specialist creative center located in beautiful Cornwall, in southwest UK. Since 1902, we’ve built a significant reputation across the breadth of the creative industries – from traditional fine art and design to game development, robotics and architecture. And this expertise is no longer confined to campus.

listings.name: University of Cambridge
listings.description: With more than 18,000 students from all walks of life and all corners of the world, nearly 9,000 staff, 31 Colleges and 150 Departments, Faculties, Schools and other institutions, no two days are ever the same at the University of Cambridge.

listings.name: Aarhus University
listings.description: Aarhus University is a dynamic, modern and highly international university. Since its founding in 1928, it has grown to become a leading public university with international impact and reach across the entire research spectrum. Aarhus is a great place to study and a great place to work

listings.name: Queen Margaret University
listings.description: At Queen Margaret University, Edinburgh, our vision is to be a university of ideas and influence.Outward looking, we are responsive to the changing needs of society and make a real difference in the world. We have widely recognised expertise in health & rehabilitation; sustainable business and creativity & culture.

listings.name: Aberystwyth University
listings.description: Choose Aberystwyth University and you’ll be studying in a location like no other. On the west coast of Wales between Cardigan Bay and the Cambrian Mountains, you’ll be part of a friendly, outward-looking community where the far horizon inspires ambition and aspiration.

listings.name: Keele University
listings.description: At Keele, they're proud to offer a diverse range of career-focused courses and a thriving student life on the beautiful 600-acre campus, with everything you need on your doorstep. Whatever your goals, at Keele the ambition is to prepare you for success. Located near both a vibrant university town and a bustling city, Keele is a global community for both academic and personal growth.

listings.name: University of the Built Environment
listings.description: University of the Built Environment prepares professionals to shape the world around us. With over 100 years of expertise and around 4,000 students worldwide, it specialises in construction, planning, architecture and real estate, offering undergraduate, postgraduate and apprenticeship programmes for ambitious learners at every stage of their career.

listings.name: University of Sheffield
listings.description: This wonderful academic community, the University of Sheffield, is such an important place for all the communities that we serve across our region, the UK and the world. And this is a crucial time for us to be thinking about our strategy.

listings.name: Oxford Brookes University
listings.description: Oxford Brookes University offers a world-class student experience in a beautiful city with a rich educational history that goes back centuries. Join one of the UK's leading modern universities, with a global reputation for teaching excellence, exciting student life and strong links with business and industry.

listings.name: Richmond American University in London
listings.description: Richmond American University London is a unique and independent institution. Awarding both UK and US degrees to all students, Richmond occupies a unique standing in global education, blending two of the world’s leading educational systems. If you want to learn about courses and career opportunities, join on Wednesday, 6 May 2026, for live postgraduate webinar, Advance Your Career.

listings.name: Birkbeck, University of London
listings.description: Founded in 1823, Birkbeck, University of London is a world-class research and teaching institution located in the heart of central London. As a College of the University of London, Birkbeck awards internationally recognised qualifications and is a world-class research and teaching institution.

listings.name: Royal Welsh College of Music & Drama
listings.description: The Royal Welsh College of Music & Drama, the National Conservatoire of Wales, and part of the University of South Wales Group, competes alongside an international peer group of conservatoires and specialist arts colleges for the best students globally, enabling students to enter and influence the world of music, theatre and related professions.

listings.name: International Business School
listings.description: International Business School is a vibrant modern business school that attracts students from around 100 countries of the world. We offer degree programmes in partnership with The University of Buckingham in Budapest and in Vienna. Being truly international, IBS is famous for its highly practical and student-focused approach that results in an outstanding employment rate after graduation.

listings.name: University of Chichester
listings.description: The University of Chichester offers a unique blend of historic charm and modern innovation on England’s south coast. Ranked among the UK’s best for teaching quality and student satisfaction, it provides career-focused degrees in a supportive community where students are known by name and encouraged to thrive.

listings.name: Warnborough College
listings.description: Warnborough College is proudly NOT an Assembly Line university. YOU design the programme for YOUR needs. Accredited non-residence Bachelors, Masters and Doctorate degrees can be earned through research, instruction, projects or publication. Alternatively, do individual modules for credit or transfers.

listings.name: The University of Law
listings.description: The University of Law is one of the longest-established specialist provider of legal education and training in the UK, with campuses in London, Birmingham, Bristol, Chester, Guildford, Leeds, Manchester and Nottingham, and an international campus in Hong Kong.

listings.name: Gisma University of Applied Sciences
listings.description: Gisma University of Applied Sciences was created with the help of local government as well as corporations including Continental, Siemens, TUI, and Volkswagen.

listings.name: Scotland's Rural College (SRUC)
listings.description: SRUC exists to deliver comprehensive skills, education and business support for Scotland’s land-based industries, founded on world-class and sector-leading research, education and consultancy.

listings.name: LIU Post
listings.description: At its core a liberal arts institution, LIU Post is dedicated to meeting the needs and expanding the horizons of all our students, whether in the arts and sciences, or professional schools or through life-long learning.

listings.name: Westford University College
listings.description: Westford University College aims to prepare the future Business Leaders by actively embracing the dynamic changes constant across the globe.

listings.name: Arden University Online
listings.description: At Arden, our ambition is to make higher education more accessible, engaging, and beneficial to people everywhere, and our flexible and affordable distance learning programmes make us a pioneer in providing UK degrees worldwide.

listings.name: The Aga Khan University
listings.description: Aga Khan University is a unique hybrid: an institution of academic excellence that is also an agent for social development. A leading source of medical, nursing and teacher education, research and public service in the developing world, the University prepares men and women to lead change in their societies and to thrive in the global economy.

listings.name: St Mary's University, Twickenham, London
listings.description: We are a strong and welcoming community of students and staff and are committed to the highest standards in teaching across the wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate courses we offer. In addition, we have a vibrant research culture and environment.

listings.name: Apsley Business School
listings.description: Here at Apsley Business School London we aim to prepare you for a professional career from day one with a wide range of study options to meet your needs, from undergraduate degrees with optional foundation years to online and accelerated postgraduate programmes. We have a wide selection of intensive and bespoke programmes and funded apprenticeships.

listings.name: London Performing Academy of Music
listings.description: The London Performing Academy of Music [LPMAM] is a new Independent International Music Conservatoire in London offering high level Classical Music education for musicians of the 21st Century.

listings.name: Roffey Park Institute
listings.description: Roffey Park Institute primes organisations to build business skills for everyone, everywhere.

listings.name: London School of Innovation
listings.description: At London School of Innovation, our commitment is to foster a sanctuary where lifelong learning, innovation, adaptability, and the art of progress are lived, not merely taught. As a community, we practice being agents of change, not only preparing for what comes next but also actively shaping it. By mastering the art of innovation, our students are poised to accelerate prosperity for all mankind.

listings.name: The Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts (LIPA)
listings.description: Whichever aspect of the performing arts you want to learn about and do, we can help you do it. We offer one of the widest ranges of skills and teaching in performing arts education in the UK. The Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts (LIPA) is a specialist university-level provider of learning for those who make performance possible.

listings.name: AMOS Sport Business School
listings.description: Choosing AMOS Sport Business School means widening your horizons and interacting with people from other cultures who share a passion for sports. If traveling enriches the mind, studying abroad definitely opens opportunities to pursue an international sports career! At AMOS we are aligned with the sports industry trends to allow our students a fast immersion in the fast-changing sports industry.

listings.name: National Design Academy
listings.description: The National Design Academy is the only institution to offer truly flexible, online interior design courses that are nationally and internationally recognised.
